scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Go and train yourself in preparation for the holy war that is coming. Victory will be in the hands of those who are most ready to receive it.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
去磨练自己，为即将到来的圣战做好准备。
胜利属于准备最充分的人。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
We are Crusaders,
warriors preparing
to fight in the Holy War.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
我们是十字军，是为迎战圣战而磨练自己的战士。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Ah...
I see that you have been called to become a Crusader. We are assured of your will, but now we must test your capabilities.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
啊...
看来你已蒙召，注定要成为十字军。
你的意志已得到认可，接下来还需考验你的能力。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
We are Crusaders, warriors preparing for the Holy War.
What brings you
to this place?
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
我们是十字军，是为圣战做准备的战士。
你来这里有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Have you proven your determination with the task I have given you, or do you possess the items proving that you have received your calling?
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
你是否完成了我交给你的任务，证明自己的决心？
或是带来了能证明你已蒙召的物品？

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
You haven't finished learning everything as a Swordsman. Use all of your remaining skill points, and then return to me.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
你还没有完成剑士的学习。
把剩余的技能点全部用完，再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Congratulations on completing all of your tests. You are truly worthy of fighting alongside side us in the Holy War as a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
恭喜你通过所有考验。
你确实有资格成为十字军，在圣战中与我们并肩作战。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
It seems that you have not yet completed all of the testing. You will not be ready to become a Crusader until you have completed the tests set before you.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
看来你还没完成所有考验。
通过这些考验后，你才能成为十字军。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
You don't belong here, my friend.
Be advised to continue practicing yourself.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
朋友，你不该来这里。
还是继续磨练自己吧。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Chaos will one day arise to challenge our principles of peace, justice and order. Until we have eliminated evil and created our ideal world, we must not cease training.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
总有一天，混乱会兴起，挑战我们坚守的和平、正义与秩序。
在消灭邪恶、创造理想世界之前，我们绝不能停止训练。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
If you wish to join us, you must first learn the Swordsman discipline and train yourself thoroughly...
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
想加入我们，就先学好剑士的技艺，充分磨练自己...

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
As it happened one thousand years ago, evil forces will one day attack in droves in an attempt to take over the world once again.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
邪恶势力终有一天会像千年前那样大举来袭，妄图再次掌控世界。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Meet with Moorenak Miyol who is training in the underground dungeon of the Prontera Castle. Go, and speak with him first.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
穆尔纳克·米茹尔正在普隆德拉王宫的地下城里训练。
先去找他谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Moorenak and others like him will test the limits of your capabilities and help you find your path. Return to me after you have completed their tests...
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
穆尔纳克和其他人会考验你的能力极限，帮你找到自己的道路。
完成他们的考验后，再回来找我...

scripts.text: I want to prepare for the Holy War!
scripts.translation: 我想为圣战做准备！

scripts.text: Nothing in particular.
scripts.translation: 没什么特别的事

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
You wish to become
a Crusader...?
Joining us is not as
easy as it sounds.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
你想成为十字军...？
加入我们可没那么容易。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
I am Michael Halig. I am one of but many Crusaders preparing for the Holy War. We continuously train ourselves with sincere faith and endless loyalty.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
我是迈克尔·哈利格，是众多为圣战做准备的十字军之一。
我们怀着虔诚的信仰和坚定不移的忠诚，不断磨练自己。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
We recruit Swordsmen that express exceptional faith, or those who were born as warriors
by Odin's will.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
我们招募信仰坚定的剑士，以及遵循奥丁意志、天生为战士的人。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Possessing the ^3355FFChivalry Emblem^000000 and ^3355FFHand of God^000000 is seen as a sign that you have been called to become a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
拥有^3355FF忠诚之证^000000和^3355FF神之手^000000，就被视为蒙召成为十字军的标志。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
After obtaining those items and passing our tests, you too, can become a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
获得这些物品并通过我们的考验后，你也能成为十字军。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
I don't know what type of person you are right now though. But
I shall test you if you desire. Are you willing to endure these tests in preparation for the Holy War?
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
我还不了解你是怎样的人，不过只要你愿意，我就会考验你。
为了迎接圣战，你愿意接受这些考验吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 我愿意

scripts.text: I'd like to think about it.
scripts.translation: 我想再考虑一下

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Wait...
You're not ready yet.
You need to be at least
Job Level 40 to become
a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
等等...
你还没准备好。
至少达到职业等级40，才能成为十字军。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Train yourself more as a Swordsman and wait for your calling. I understand your intent, but as of now, you cannot join us.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
继续以剑士的身份磨练自己，等待召唤吧。
我明白你的志向，不过现在还不能让你加入。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
You haven't finished learning everything as a Swordsman. Use all of your remaining skill points, and then return to me.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
你还没有完成剑士的学习。
把剩余的技能点全部用完，再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Then...
I shall test you to see if you are fit to become a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
那么...
我会考验你，看你是否有资格成为十字军。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Your name is
{0}...?
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
你的名字是 {0}...？
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Ah...
I see that you have been called to become a Crusader. We are assured of your will, but now we must test your capabilities.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
啊...
看来你已蒙召，注定要成为十字军。
你的意志已得到认可，接下来还需考验你的能力。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Meet with Moorenak Miyol who is training in the underground dungeon of the Prontera Castle. Go, and speak with him first.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
穆尔纳克·米茹尔正在普隆德拉王宫的地下城里训练。
先去找他谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Moorenak and others like him will test the limits of your capabilities and help you find your path. Return to me after you have completed their tests...
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
穆尔纳克和其他人会考验你的能力极限，帮你找到自己的道路。
完成他们的考验后，再回来找我...

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Mmm. I can't discern whether or not you have the heart to become a Crusader. However, if you have the will and put forth the effort, you may have what it takes.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
嗯，我还看不出你是否有成为十字军的决心。
不过，只要意志坚定、肯付出努力，你也许就有这份资质。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Now...
This is my test for you. Bring me the following items and prove your determination to me.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
现在...
这就是我给你的考验。
带来以下物品，向我证明你的决心。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Show me the strength of your will by gathering these items. If you prove successful, you will progress to the next test. May Odin protect you.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
收集这些物品，证明你的意志有多坚定。
完成后，就能接受下一项考验。
愿奥丁护佑你。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Nobody knows when the Holy War will come. We must prepare in advance and cannot afford to slacken
our training.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
没人知道圣战何时到来。
我们必须提前准备，训练一刻也不能松懈。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
If you feel that participating in the Holy War is your calling, please come back right away and take the test to become
a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
如果你觉得参加圣战是自己的使命，就尽快回来接受转职十字军的考验。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
If you, too, are a man of the sword, constantly train and prepare yourself. No one knows when the Holy War may begin.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
既然你也是剑士，就要不断磨练自己，做好准备。
没人知道圣战何时会开始。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
As a woman of the sword, you must train diligently and constantly. Prepare yourself, for no one knows when the Holy War may be coming.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
身为女剑士，你必须坚持勤奋训练，做好准备。
没人知道圣战何时会到来。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Ah, well done.
I must acknowledge your efforts and determination. You may now proceed to take the next test.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
啊，做得好。
你的努力和决心已得到认可。
现在可以接受下一项考验了。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Meet with Moorenak Miyol who is training in the underground dungeon of the Prontera Castle. Go, and speak with him first.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
穆尔纳克·米茹尔正在普隆德拉王宫的地下城里训练。
先去找他谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Moorenak and others like him will test the limits of your capabilities and help you find your path. Return to me after you have completed their tests...
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
穆尔纳克和其他人会考验你的能力极限，帮你找到自己的道路。
完成他们的考验后，再回来找我...

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Ah, you still have not completed the task I have given to you. Bring me the following items, and prove your will to become a Crusader to me...
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
啊，你还没完成我交给你的任务。
带来以下物品，向我证明你成为十字军的决心...

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
If you put forth the effort, you'll be able to accomplish this task. May Odin protect you on your journeys.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
只要肯努力，就能完成这项任务。
愿奥丁护佑你的旅途。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Together, let us ready ourselves and be victorious over evil and tyranny!
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
让我们共同做好准备，战胜邪恶与暴政！

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Behold...!
You are now a Crusader!
When the Holy War comes, we shall fight side by side against the forces of evil.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
看...！
你已经是十字军了！
圣战来临时，我们将并肩对抗邪恶势力。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Now you are
one of us!
...Brother.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
现在，你也是我们的一员了！
...兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Now you are
one of us!
...Comrade.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
现在，你也是我们的一员了！
...战友。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
And use this in times of dire peril. It will give you strength when your wounds are most grievous.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
危急时就使用这个。
当你伤势严重时，它会为你带来力量。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Never forget that the Holy War is approaching. We must be prepare for the inevitable tide of evil that will sweep this world. Now, go forth and fight for the principles of freedom and justice!
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
别忘了，圣战正在逼近。
邪恶的浪潮终将席卷世界，我们必须做好准备。
现在，出发吧，为自由与正义而战！

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Return to me when you have completed all of your tests. When you finally prove eligible, you will join the proud ranks of the mighty Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
完成所有考验后，再来找我。
当你证明自己的资格，就能加入强大而光荣的十字军行列。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Don't linger around in a place like this and forge your own path towards discovering your own strengths. The day that we will join hands in battle will come soon.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
别在这种地方逗留，去开辟自己的道路，发掘自身的力量吧。
我们并肩作战的日子很快就会到来。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
A Novice...?
So green, and yet,
so much potential.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
初心者...？
虽然稚嫩，却有无限潜力。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Hm. You have no business in a place like this. Please leave, and do not interrupt my training.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
嗯，这里没有你的事。
请离开，别打扰我的修行。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
What do you want...?
If you have no business here,
then please leave. A tranquil state of mind is essential in self training...
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
你有什么事...？
没事的话，就请离开。
修行必须保持心境平和...

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
What is it...?
Do you have business
with me, man of the sword?
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
怎么了...？
剑士，你找我有事吗？

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
What is it...?
Do you have business
with me, woman of the sword?
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
怎么了...？
女剑士，你找我有事吗？

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
What is it...?
You're the Swordman from before. What happened, did you fail?
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
怎么了...？
是之前那位剑士啊。
没通过考验吗？

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Hmm, seems like you did well. It shouldn't have been too hard. You no longer have any business
with me.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
嗯，看来你做得不错。
应该不算太难吧。
我这里已经没有你的事了。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Hmmm...
You still have tests to complete if you want to become a Crusader, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
嗯...
想成为十字军，你还有其他考验要完成，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Let me assure you that I'm no criminal. I'm here merely to train myself. Perhaps as you become stronger, you will understand.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
放心，我不是罪犯，只是在这里修行。
等你变得更强，也许就会明白了。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
I wish to improve the sense of serenity in my heart in preparation for the Holy War that is to come. So please, do not disturb me.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
为了迎接圣战，我正在修炼，让内心更加平静。
所以请别打扰我。

scripts.text: I'd like to take the Crusader test.
scripts.translation: 我想参加十字军考核

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
You wish to become a Crusader...? Hm, fighting in the Holy War is an admirable goal we may both share.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
你想成为十字军...？
嗯，为圣战而战是个崇高的目标，也许你我志向相同。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Your name is
{0}...?
Let me take
a look at your face.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
你的名字是 {0}...？
让我看看你的脸。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Hmm. You wish to become a Crusader, but do not wear a Rosary? I have no business with you if you cannot uphold our customs.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
嗯，想成为十字军，却不佩戴念珠？
连我们的传统都不遵守，我也没什么好跟你说的。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Hmm...
You seem so-so, but also young and ambitious. Ambition may work against you if it is not tempered with patience.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
嗯...
你看起来资质平平，不过年轻而有抱负。
没有耐心约束，抱负也可能成为阻碍。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Don't give me a reason to doubt you, and show me your patience. You must endure my test with your patience if you wish to become a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
别让我怀疑你，证明你的耐心吧。
想成为十字军，就得耐心承受我的考验。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
You may take my test right away. It's actually quite simple. All you must do is walk to the end of the corridor.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
现在就可以开始。
考验很简单，只要走到走廊尽头就行。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
But...
You must keep one thing in mind. Under no condition are you allowed to kill the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
不过...
有一点必须记住：无论如何，都不许杀死魔物。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Well then...
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
那么...
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
You seem to have a lot of time on your hands. Why don't you do something more productive, like pick Jellopy off the streets or something?
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
你似乎很闲啊。
不如做点有用的事，比如去街上捡些杰勒比结晶？

scripts.text: Let me retake the test.
scripts.translation: 让我再考一次

scripts.text: What kind of test was that?!
scripts.translation: 这算什么考验？！

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
I'll let you retake the test as much as you like. But if you continuously fail, there's an inherent problem with your
state of mind.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
想重考多少次都可以。
不过，如果一直失败，那就是心态有问题了。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Wait...
Where have you left your Rosary? You can't let that lie around just anywhere. We are supposed to be warriors of holiness.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
等等...
你把念珠放哪了？
可不能随便乱放。
我们是神圣的战士。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Carelessly losing things is an attitude for mere Swordsmen. If you really want to retake the test, you must respect the Crusader traditions.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
粗心大意、丢三落四，那是普通剑士的做派。
真想重考，就得尊重十字军的传统。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Your problem is your habit of hitting monsters the moment you see one. You must develop your patience and endurance.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
你的问题就是看见魔物就动手。
必须学会忍耐，磨练耐力。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Just focus...
Your only goal is to walk from one end of the corridor to the other. It's simple when you think
about it.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
专心一点...
你的目标只有一个，就是从走廊这头走到那头。
想清楚了，其实很简单。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
No matter what you do, do not kill any of the monsters. This time, think carefully before you draw your sword.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
无论做什么，都不能杀死魔物。
这次拔剑之前，先想清楚。

[Murnak Mijoul]
Well then...
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
那么...
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Who are you to say that you don't like my test? With that kind of attitude, you'll never become a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
凭什么嫌弃我的考验？
这种态度，永远当不了十字军。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
I can understand if you are easily frustrated, but you must overcome your frustration to pass this test.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
容易受挫，我可以理解。
不过，想通过考验，你就得克服这种情绪。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
For your next test, go look for Gabriel Valentine in the Prontera Sanctuary. Well then, I'll see you around.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
下一项考验，去普隆德拉圣堂找加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁。
那么，回头见。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Welcome, fellow Crusader.
How is your training
coming along?
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
欢迎，十字军战友。
训练进展如何？

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Welcome, I am a Crusader.
I am preparing for the
foretold Holy War
that is to come.

[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]

我正在为预言中的圣战做准备。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Like I mentioned before, you should go to Prontera Castle and meet with Bliant Piyord to take your next test. Good luck, and become a Crusder soon, alright?

[Gabriel Valentine]

[Gabriel Valentine]

scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]

[Gabriel Valentine]

[Gabriel Valentine]
If you would like to become a Crusader, please speak with our leader in the Prontera Central Palace.

[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]

My name is Gabriel Valentine. I, too, am preparing for the Holy War. For the time being, I act as guard for this church.

We can't very well win the Holy War just by swinging a sword.

scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
{0}的得分是{1}分...
做得很好~
现在可以接受下一项考验了。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
 {0}'s score
is {1} points...
Seems like you prepared a lot so I'll let you pass this time.
Hurry now and go take the next test.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
{0}的得分是{1}分...
看得出你认真准备过，这次就让你通过吧。
快去接受下一项考验。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
 {0}'s score
is {1} points...
Hmmm... What a pity.
Go study some more and
take this test again, okay?
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
{0}的得分是{1}分...
嗯...真可惜。
再多复习一些，然后回来重考，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Go to Prontera Castle
and meet Bliant Piyord.
I will inform him that
he will be testing you next.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
去普隆德拉王宫找布莱恩特·皮约德。
我会通知他，由他主持你的下一项考验。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Go to Prontera Castle
and meet Bliant Piyord.
I will inform him that
he will be testing you next.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
去普隆德拉王宫找布莱恩特·皮约德。
我会通知他，由他主持你的下一项考验。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Go to the Prontera Castle and meet Bliant Piyord.
I will inform him to prepare the next test.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
去普隆德拉王宫找布莱恩特·皮约德。
我会通知他准备下一项考验。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Don't stress, you need to know a lot in order to pass this test. In any case, I'll be waiting right here. When you think you're ready, come back, alright?
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
别着急，这项考验需要掌握不少知识才能通过。
我会在这里等你。
准备好了再回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
You will soon join us in our preparations for the Holy War. Continue to live with faith after becoming a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
你很快就能加入我们，共同为圣战做准备了。
成为十字军后，也要始终坚守信仰。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Finish those other tests,
and come to me once you're
instructed. Until then,
I'll see you later~
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
先完成其他考验，等有人指引你来时再来找我。
那么，回头见~

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
How goes
your training?
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
欢迎。
训练进展如何？

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
We are Crusaders,
warriors of holiness preparing for the great Holy War that is to come.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
欢迎。
我们是十字军，是为即将到来的伟大圣战做准备的神圣战士。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
It's nice
to meet you.
It is now time
for your final test.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
欢迎。
很高兴见到你。
现在该接受最后的考验了。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
Are you prepared
for the test now?
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
欢迎。
现在准备好接受考验了吗？

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
Congratulations.
You have completed
all the tests to
become a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
欢迎。
恭喜，你已经完成了转职十字军所需的全部考验。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
Are you not one of the ones in the process of becoming a Crusader?
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
欢迎。
你不是正在接受十字军转职考验的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Develop your faith. From faith springs strength and discipline. Day after day, train yourself and become a great Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
坚定你的信仰。
力量与自律都源自信仰。
日复一日地磨练自己，成为出色的十字军吧。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Are you interested
in becoming a Crusader?
We are always waiting
for more capable men and
women to join our ranks.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
想成为十字军吗？
我们随时欢迎有能力的男女加入。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Train as a Swordsman and come to us when you think you are ready. If you have been called by Odin to become a Crusader, that would be even better.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
先以剑士的身份磨练自己，觉得准备好了再来找我们。
如果你已蒙奥丁召唤，注定成为十字军，那就更好了。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Even in these relatively peaceful times, our training is ceaseless. We must be ready for the day with the tides of darkness shall rush against mankind...
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
即使如今还算和平，我们也从不停止训练。
黑暗浪潮终将涌向人类，我们必须为那一天做好准备...

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Are you interested
in becoming a Crusader?
We are always waiting
for more capable men and
women to join our ranks.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
想成为十字军吗？
我们随时欢迎有能力的男女加入。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
To become a Crusader, you must train until you are Job Level 40. For more details, please speak with our leader inside.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
想成为十字军，必须先练到职业等级40。
详情请去里面找我们的首领了解。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
May Odin
be with you...
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
愿奥丁与你同在...

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
My name is Bliant Piyord and I too, am preparing for the Holy War. It must've been quite a hassle to come all this way.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
我叫布莱恩特·皮约德，也在为圣战做准备。
一路奔波到这里，想必很辛苦吧。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
This test will gauge your skills in battle. Only those with great fighting ability can become Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
这项考验会检验你的战斗技巧。
只有战斗能力出众的人，才能成为十字军。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
To take the battle test, bring
1 ^3355FFHoly Water^000000. This will be used to purify you prior to taking the test.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
参加实战考核，需要带来1瓶^3355FF圣水^000000。
考核前会用它为你净化。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Well then...
Shall we
begin right away?
Or do you need time
to prepare yourself?
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
那么...
现在就开始吗？
还是需要些时间准备？

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Would you like to begin now, or do you still need time to make preparations?
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
你想现在开始，还是还需要时间做准备？

scripts.text: I would like to begin.
scripts.translation: 我想开始

scripts.text: Give me some time to prepare.
scripts.translation: 给我一点时间准备

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Just a second, you do not have a Rosary equipped. As a Crusader, you must always have a Rosary on your person.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
等等，你还没装备念珠。
身为十字军，必须时刻随身带着念珠。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Come back and take
the test after you
have a Rosary.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
有了念珠，再回来接受考验吧。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
For the battle test, please prepare one ^3355FFHoly water^000000.
I told you just to purify the candidates.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
参加实战考核，请准备1瓶^3355FF圣水^000000。
我说过，这是用来净化考生的。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Get prepares and come back to here.
I will wait for you.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
准备好再来。
我会等你。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Then, I'll start
the test. You will
be purified with the
Holy Water you prepared.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
那么，开始考核。
先用你带来的圣水为你净化。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
...............

[Bliant Piyord]
Let's begin.
Go and enter
the waiting room.
Defeat the monsters
that appear in
the 4 stages.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
开始吧。
请进入候考室。
击败四个阶段中出现的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Prepare 1 ^3355FFHoly Water^000000 to take the battle test. As I've said, it will be used to purify you prior to taking the test.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
参加实战考核，请准备1瓶^3355FF圣水^000000。
之前说过，考核前会用它为你净化。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Come back and take
the test after you
have prepared
1 Holy Water.
I shall be
waiting.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
准备好1瓶圣水，再回来接受考验。
我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Go talk to our
leader inside.
We welcome you into
the ranks of those
preparing for the
coming Holy War.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
去里面找我们的首领谈谈。
欢迎你加入我们的行列，共同为即将到来的圣战做准备。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
It's not your turn
to take my test yet.
Come back after taking
all the other tests.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
还没轮到你接受我的考验。
先完成其他所有考验，再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
I'll see you soon.
May Odin's blessings
be with you.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
回头见。
愿奥丁的祝福与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
You will take
the last test here.
If you are ready for
the test, enter the
waiting room.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
欢迎。
最后一项考验就在这里进行。
准备好了，就进入候考室吧。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Only one person can take the test at a time. If someone else is already testing, please wait until the testing area is made available once again.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
每次只能有一人参加考核。
如果有人正在考试，请等考场空出来。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Each person will get 4 minutes to complete the test. If you wish to leave in the middle of the test, please disconnect from the game.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
每人有4分钟完成考核。
如果想中途退出，请断开游戏连接。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Go forth and defeat all
the monsters that appear.
You will not pass if any
are remaining.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
去击败所有出现的魔物。
只要还有一只留下，就无法通过。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
You will be given
4 minutes. Go forth
and do your best...
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
你有4分钟。
去吧，全力以赴...
